request: Second set of three reviews explicitly requested after initial three-pass review

rounds.focus: Failure semantics of both package managers
rounds.finding: The earlier shell if/pipeline swallowed package query exit failures and stderr, yielding success with an empty result.
rounds.fix: Capture the opkg status result and propagate its exit. For APK, first read installed names, then query versions only for known installed libraries; every query failure propagates, including exit 1.

rounds.focus: Version parsing and exact package identity
rounds.finding: An invalid or duplicated installed-library version must not be treated as missing.
rounds.fix: Reject invalid, empty or duplicate version rows. Exact installed-name membership prevents similarly named packages from satisfying the library check.
rounds.result: Actual library versions in all 3602 current common/capture profile records parsed correctly.

rounds.focus: Full installer call chain and legacy compatibility
rounds.result: Real shell fault injected into full hcx installation blocks library installation, upload and hcx mutation for both managers. Legacy status command and normal format retained. Existing version pin, wrong-architecture, hash, unrelated package plan, timeout, cancellation, cleanup and post-install verification tests rerun.

source_scope.checks: Source SHA256 rechecked; opkg missing-name status returns success with no installed record; APK no-name info lists installed names.

delivery.hcx_application_fix: source only; not installed by an offline dependency ZIP

limitation: Official-source review and offline regression are not universal live-device certification.
